attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 19, `oxyR` to `metF`, are carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 3% of calls. The model names 89 to 100% of them, fewest at column 1, `argH`, 89%.

Through columns 47 to 54 a branch of 8 shell families runs in 11 to 13%, [[phage tail assembly]].

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 97 against 90%, and hesitates less there, 0.15 against 0.41 bits. It hesitates most at column 79, `yihT`, a fork column, 0.68 bits.

**The last column is `yihT`**, in 31% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 94% of genes**, 0.26 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.85 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 80% against 96%.

label: oxyR
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the oxyR window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor oxyR, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 4,161 to 4,240 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying oxyR once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.26 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 34,829 calls, named 98%, 0.13 bits; shell 7,746 calls, named 81%, 0.70 bits; cloud 545 calls, named 22%, 2.62 bits. Outside an RGP 36,724 calls, named 96%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 6,396 calls, named 80%, 0.85 bits. Columns: 46 spine, 24 fork, 10 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.85 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (80% against 96%); 6,396 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 79 (yihT, a fork column) 0.68 bits, RGP 76%; column 78 (yihU, a variable column) 0.63 bits, RGP 73%; column 25 (rpmE, a spine column) 0.60 bits, RGP 12%. The 8 columns (columns 61-64 and 76-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 88%, 0.52 bits on average; the other 72 columns: named 95%, 0.23 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 46 spine columns: named 97%, 0.15 bits on average; the 34 fork and variable columns: named 90%, 0.41 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 79, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 47-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 6-76%; the least: columns 0-19 (spine), RGP 0-3%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-19 (20 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-3%. Genes: oxyR, argH, argB "acetylglutamate kinase", argC, argE, ppc, eptC, yijO "AraC family transcriptional regulat…", frwD, pflC "[formate-C-acetyltransferase]-activ…", pflD, frwB, frwC "PTS fructose transporter subunit EI…", ptsP, fsa, gldA, yijF "DUF1287 domain-containing protein", yijE "cystine transporter YijE", katG, metF. named 89-100% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1 (argH), named 89%, 0.50 bits.
[S2] 2. column 20 variable: share 63%, all S, RGP 2%. named 89%; 0.49 bits.
[S2.c20]    20: "hypothetical protein" S 63%
[S3] 3. columns 21-46 (26 columns) spine: share 95-99%, all P, RGP 0.4-14%. Genes: metL "bifunctional aspartate kinase/homos…", metB, metJ, yiiX "YiiX family permuted papain-like en…", rpmE, priA, cytR, ftsN, hslV, hslU "HslU--HslV peptidase ATPase subunit", menA, rraA, zapB, glpF "glycerol uptake facilitator protein…", glpK, glpX, fpr, uspD, yiiS "DUF406 domain-containing protein", yiiR "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yiiQ "YiiQ family protein", tpiA, cdh, sbp, pfkA, fieF. named 75-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 25 (rpmE), named 75%, 0.60 bits.
